nodes.label: Custom iOS-Style UI Component Kit (src/ui)
nodes.rationale: The UI kit is deliberately kept free of app knowledge (zero domain imports) so it can be reused across member, coach and admin screens and stay swappable.

nodes.label: Private Coach Routines
nodes.rationale: Routines are namespaced under routines/{coachId} and kept private to the creating coach, so a coach can reuse a template without exposing it to peers in the same gym.

nodes.label: Exercise Library
nodes.rationale: A curated, gym-wide library keeps demo media and metric definitions in one place so coaches assign rather than re-author exercises, and members always see the same reference media.

nodes.label: Gym Coach Signup Codes
nodes.rationale: Self-service coach signup is gated by a per-gym code stored in gymCodes/{gymId} and admin-read-only, letting coaches join the right gym without an admin manually provisioning each account.

nodes.label: iOS Design Tokens (Colors, SF Type Ramp, Spacing, Radius)
nodes.norm_label: ios design tokens (colors, sf type ramp, spacing, radius)

nodes.label: Multi-Gym Multi-Role Architecture
nodes.rationale: A single codebase and a single Firebase project serve many gyms and three role tiers; tenancy is modelled as a gymId field on users rather than separate apps or databases, so one deployment can onboard new gyms without code changes.

nodes.label: React Native + Expo + TypeScript Multi-Platform App
nodes.norm_label: react native + expo + typescript multi-platform app

nodes.label: Realtime Database Data Model
nodes.rationale: Denormalized paths (gyms, gymCodes, users, exercises, routines, assignments, completions, measurements) key assignments by date and completions by uid/date so a member's day is a single read and RTDB listeners can subscribe narrowly.

nodes.label: Roles Bootstrap (First Admin via Console)
nodes.rationale: There is no privileged signup path; the first admin is seeded by editing users/{uid}.role in the Firebase console, and all later role changes flow through the admin Users tab.

nodes.label: Live Sync via Realtime Database Listeners
nodes.norm_label: live sync via realtime database listeners
nodes.rationale: RTDB listeners replace polling so a coach's assignment appears on the member's Today screen instantly and everything stays consistent across devices in the same gym.

nodes.label: Type-Driven Exercise Metrics
nodes.rationale: An exercise type (strength, cardio, other) selects which metric fields apply, with 'other' allowing admin-defined custom fields — trading rigid schema for per-exercise flexibility.
